correctness.rationale: PASS: The 24-edge cube-to-axis model gives the two exhaustive generic normal chambers. Explicit cyclic determinant sums yield both exact formulas; continuity covers their walls. On the hexagonal chamber Cauchy-Schwarz and the identity (sum)^2-2||n||^2=4bc-(a-b-c)^2 certify both bounds with equality. On the octagonal chamber an exactly reconstructed 28-term nonnegative Bernstein polynomial certifies the upper bound, and a derivative numerator monotone in the squared coordinate difference reduces the lower bound to the two exact endpoint functions. The standalone checker passed symbolic proofs and independent numeric edge-intersection reconstruction for 2000 normals.

Relevant published-finding corpus records concern illumination, boundary clearance, affine-section polygon counts, and fourth moments, not this claim. Broad section theory remains a nonzero historical-priority risk, so novelty is provisional rather than certified.
